content:
The AEC FORUM 2024 – OPPORTUNITIES, STRATEGY AND INNOVATION organised by PTPC is taking place on 5 December. In this 13th edition, the event will be divided into two parts: in the morning the theme will be ‘Entrepreneurship and Innovation in the AEC Sector’, and the afternoon will be dedicated to ‘Construction 2035 – Strategy and Opportunities’.

BUILT CoLAB will participate in the morning with presentations by Luís Sanhudo, Head of Digital Transformation, on ‘Technological Challenges for the Digital Transformation of Construction’, and Vanessa Tavares, Head of Sustainability, on ‘How can companies and local authorities be more sustainable in the management of their Built Environment?’.

In the afternoon, João Moutinho, Director of BUILT CoLAB, will take part in the round table of Panel 2, which will discuss ‘Innovation, Digitalisation, Industrialisation, Sustainability, Regulation, Qualification and Focus on Society’.

The AEC Forum will take place in person at the Beato Creative Hub, formerly Fábrica do Pão, between 10am and 6.30pm, and will be an excellent opportunity to find out about the latest trends in the AEC sector, as well as attend various debates on current events in the industry and network with some of the main players in the market.

Registration is free (lunch not included), but compulsory here, where you can also see the full programme.
